issues.title: protasis-wish: recover Wildcat V1 deployment epochs and build inputs
issues.body:

This is a source-recovery child of https://github.com/wildcat-finance/skills/issues/1482, under the [approved scope](https://github.com/wildcat-finance/skills/pull/1583#issuecomment-5655443034). Surveyor under Protasis owns recovery; the target reviewer checks the resulting source/deployment mapping.

Registry rows: `wildcat-v1-ethereum-mainnet` in `docs/kickoff/1359/targets.json`.

Pin the V1 factory, controllers, stored init code and covered market instances on Ethereum. Recover exact source revisions and compiler inputs, reproduce the code matches, and bind each deployment epoch to block hashes. Preserve the distinct arch-controller and sanctions-sentinel revisions.
